code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and low lymphocyte and neutrophil percentages, with elevated monocytes, eosinophils, and basophils. Red cell indices and other biochemistry are within normal limits. These findings may suggest bone marrow suppression or an ongoing infection/inflammatory process. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
